title: Field-level evidence object for schema-guided Web extraction
description: Formalization of e_ij = <u,h,t,l,r,v,n,pi>, augmented with record and field identifiers as described in Section 9.1 of the manuscript.

record_id.description: Identifier of the output record/entity to which the field belongs.

source_url.description: u: source URL from which the evidence was obtained.

snapshot_hash.description: h: content or snapshot digest that fixes the evaluated source state.

retrieved_at.description: t: retrieval or snapshot timestamp in RFC 3339 form.

locator.description: l: structural and/or visual locator for the supporting source fragment.

bbox.description: Optional visual bounding box [x, y, width, height] in the referenced snapshot.

raw_text.description: r: exact supporting text or attribute value captured from the located source fragment.

value.description: v: extracted field value before normalization.

normalized_value.description: n: value after the declared normalization pipeline.

transformations.description: pi: ordered transformation history from raw/extracted value to normalized value. Empty when normalization is identity.
